title: Rachika Nayar’s Heaven Come Crashing is an instrumental epic of desperate longing
summary: Two minutes and thirty seconds into the title track of Rachika Nayar’s Heaven Come Crashing , an absolutely massive drum and bass beat drops. Heaven Comes Crashing is almost entirely drum-free, too.
